thread:
omar (Eng Manager): Heads-up: our Barcelona pod asked if they can swap a local holiday (La Mercè observed) that falls on company shutdown for a weekday off the following week. They're worried about losing it due to carryover rules.

carmen (People Ops): short answer: we try to avoid automatic forfeiture for local statutory days. need to check two things: 1) whether the day is statutory in Spain (looks like yes), 2) payroll cutoffs and whether this employee is eligible for carryover under local rules.

leo (EMEA HR): confirmed La Mercè is statutory in Barcelona. per our local entitlements, statutory observances tied to locale can be swapped if you file a Time-Off Exception and provide manager approval. we usually allow a 1-day swap to a proximate workday.

omar (Eng Manager): great. is there a deadline to file? team wants to take Mon 10/11 instead of losing the day.

carmen (People Ops): deadline: submit Time-Off Exception by the payroll invoice cutoff for that month. For October changes, cutoff is 09/25. if you miss cutoff we can still approve the swap but it will reflect on the next payroll run. also include a short justification: "Local statutory observance swap - La Mercè"

jun (Payroll): FYI payroll: when we process swaps for statutory days we tag them as "Locale observance swap" to keep audit trail. if it's a mass request across the Barcelona office please notify Finance so we can bundle it into the same journal entry.

omar (Eng Manager): this is just two folks. I'll get their approval screenshots. one follow-up: do contractors get this treatment?

leo (EMEA HR): contractors: only if contract explicitly references statutory local holidays. otherwise they do not automatically receive floating swaps. exceptions can be made case-by-case but require vendor/legal signoff.

carmen (People Ops): process summary: 1) employees submit PTO for the replacement date in WorkDay and set comment "Statutory swap - La Mercè". 2) manager posts approval screenshot in the Time-Off Exception form. 3) People Ops files exception and notifies Payroll with the exception ID. 4) Payroll posts tagging for audit.

omar (Eng Manager): copy. i'll ask them to submit today. also they were asking about headcount coverage if multiple people swap into the same week. any guidance on roster limits?

carmen (People Ops): good Q. rostering rule: no more than 20% of a pod can be scheduled off for a specific replacement day without manager-level signoff from the director. if it exceeds 20% we escalate to People Ops for a coverage plan.

leo (EMEA HR): and note: if the replacement day falls on an EU public holiday we treat it as an additional statutory day and payroll will process differently. check the calendar before approving.

omar (Eng Manager): we'll keep it to two people, so under the 20% threshold. submitting approvals now.

time-off-bot: automated reminder set: "Submit Time-Off Exception - Local Observance" on 2026-09-20 for Barcelona office.

jun (Payroll): once you have the exception ID paste it here so I can tag it. if submitted by 09/25 it'll show in October close; otherwise it runs in November.

carmen (People Ops): tiny policy note for records: floating holiday expiry vs statutory swap: floating holidays expire year-end unless a carryover is approved; statutory observance swaps do not count as floating holidays and therefore do not expire the same way.

omar (Eng Manager): thanks all. both requests submitted and manager approval attached. IDs: TOE-3310 and TOE-3311.

jun (Payroll): received TOE-3310/3311. queued for October close. tagging finance.

carmen (People Ops): resolving thread. if more than 2-3 people ask in the same pod, please escalate early so we can coordinate coverage. :white_check_mark:
